column1: # Cluster tier roster -- THE single source of truth for node topology.
# Was duplicated verbatim across pick_nodes.sh, seed_mesh.py, clean_tier_data.sh
# and launch_mesh_pool.sh; a node added to one and not the others silently
# desynced SLURM node picking from mesh seeding. Read this file instead of
# re-declaring a roster anywhere.
# Row order is TIER PREFERENCE ORDER (best GPU first) -- pick_nodes.sh walks it
# top-down. Fields are tab-separated: tier, subnet, comma-separated nodes.
# Subnets matter: a single cross-switch uplink caps at ~0.94 Gbps TOTAL while the
# intra-switch backplane is non-blocking, so a job must never mix subnets
# (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-30-cluster-tier1-findings.md T2.3). countries
# shares /254 with fish and orchids shares /253 with birds -- never mix those
# tiers anyway, GPU heterogeneity causes stragglers (T5.3).
# GPU tiers (T1.7 VRAM ramp): fish RTX3090 25.3GB | birds A5000 25.3GB |
# cars RTX4000Ada 21.0GB | countries A4000 16.7GB | orchids RTX2000Ada 16.7GB.
# Deliberately absent: bones (never listed), rivers/department nodes (ain,
# allier, ardennes, ...) -- GPU type unconfirmed. node114 is on /252 but has a
# high-latency cross-subnet path; login-node is the login node. Both are excluded
# by pick_nodes.sh, not by omission here.
# tier
fish
birds
cars
countries
orchids
